Selection Structures
Part 2
Selection structures allow a program to make decisions based
on conditions. Instead of always executing every line of code in
order, a selection structure lets the program choose between
different paths.

Combining Conditions
Sometimes a single condition is not enough to describe the logic we want.
In these situations, multiple conditions can be combined to create more
complex decisions.
Python provides the and and or operators to combine conditions into a
single expression.

Truth Tables

possible combination of inputs.
